source.privacy_note: Raw source contains personal identity fields. This derivative retains only registration reference, literal registry status, stated destination and timestamp.

id_allocation.preassigned_note: 22 REGAGE registrations in the pending DP1901/E.G.745 identity map retain their already reserved stable IDs. The two S-reference A02 rows are outside this REGAGE export and are not part of this reconciliation.
id_allocation.generic_rule: Chronological ascending timestamp, then REGAGE reference; existing formal IDs reused; 22 reserved REGAGE IDs preserved; mailbox 1001+ band untouched.

proof_boundary: A status-export row proves only that the supplied REG/RedSARA export records the stated reference, destination, timestamp and literal status. It does not by itself prove onward delivery, internal routing, incorporation, admission, examination, merits, requested relief or criminal responsibility.
